# E0250: a published version's schema was changed

Once a version is published, instances are validated against it as it was
published, so its schema never changes. Here the candidate's 0.0 narrows
name, which the published 0.0 left as any string. A change, compatible or not,
is a new version: here, the tip, cut as 0.1 or 1.0.

## Example

`candidate/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string & !=""
}
```

`published/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0250]: the schema in history/0.0.thema is not as published
 --> history/0.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: a published version never changes: instances were validated against it as it was published
  = help: restore the schema in history/0.0.thema as it was published, and make the change in a new version
```
